column1: # 32_06_renode pinned downloads (tab separated; see lib/boxtool.bash for the columns).
# Checked 2026-10-24. GitHub digests from the release API; dl.antmicro.com files carry their sha1 in the name.
# coverview: the static build GitHub Pages serves (gh-pages @ 16d3e89, built from main @ cb550b9); archive sha256 computed here.
# girdl: Ghidra plugin (Antmicro, Apache-2.0), main @ f28fc4a (2025-12-01); built against ghidra below with gradle + jdk (Ghidra 12.2 needs Java >= 25 and Gradle >= 9.1).
# renode-rdl: SystemRDL register descriptions of Renode's models (dated nightly; 1.17.0 has no RDL asset). Nightlies are
# pruned from builds.renode.io after a while: the cached copy keeps working, a fresh machine may need a newer date.
# west-renode-gen: Zephyr module (Antmicro): `west renode-gen` (dts2repl -> board .resc/board.cmake) + Zephyr patches for twister --coverage-tool renode. main @ a7ac650 (2026-09-24)
# renode-nightly: dated Renode build (builds.renode.io, sha256 from its sha256sums/), installed only on request and used
# only where 1.17.0 lacks something: models newer than 1.17.0 (ESP32-S3 USB serial in zephyr_dashboard).
